put.summary: Choose or hand-tune the health scoring config
put.description:
Change what the health score treats as risky. Send exactly one of the two fields.

preset_key picks one of the presets listed by GET /health-config. config sets the
seven values by hand, and every one of them must be inside bounds from that same
response - anything outside is a 400, not a clamp. The three weights must also sum
to 1.

Hand-tuned values that happen to match a preset are stored as that preset, so the
response can come back with source preset and a preset_key you did not send. The
response is always the full config payload, so there is no need to re-fetch.

portfolio_id.title: Portfolio Id
portfolio_id.description: null when nothing has been imported yet

account_type.title: Account Type
account_type.description: zar, tfsa or usd. Null until the user sets it

account_type.title: Account Type
account_type.description: zar, tfsa or usd, case-insensitive. Null clears the setting and the TFSA-only figures stop being calculated

tax_year.title: Tax Year
tax_year.description: SARS tax year the figures below come from

annual_exclusion.title: Annual Exclusion
annual_exclusion.description: rands of capital gain excluded before the inclusion rate applies

inclusion_rate.title: Inclusion Rate
inclusion_rate.description: fraction of the remaining gain added to taxable income, not percentage points

available.title: Available
available.description: false when the estimate cannot be made; read reason for why

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: why the estimate is unavailable. Null when it is available

net_unrealised_gain.title: Net Unrealised Gain
net_unrealised_gain.description: rands of gain that would be realised if everything were sold today

taxable_capital_gain.title: Taxable Capital Gain
taxable_capital_gain.description: rands left after the annual exclusion and the inclusion rate

assessed_capital_loss.title: Assessed Capital Loss
assessed_capital_loss.description: rands of loss carried forward instead of a gain. Null when the position is a gain

holdings_from_statement_only.title: Holdings From Statement Only
holdings_from_statement_only.description: tickers priced off the statement rather than live, so their share of the estimate is as stale as the statement

current_allocation_pct.title: Current Allocation Pct
current_allocation_pct.description: percentage points of the book in this holding

target_allocation_pct.title: Target Allocation Pct
target_allocation_pct.description: percentage points the active health config treats as the ceiling

value_to_reduce.title: Value To Reduce
value_to_reduce.description: rands to sell to reach the target

shares_to_sell.title: Shares To Sell
shares_to_sell.description: the same move in units, at the price used to value the holding

look_through_note.title: Look Through Note
look_through_note.description: warns when an ETF's own top holding is something also held directly. Null when there is no overlap to report
examples: This ETF is itself 7% Naspers, which you also hold directly.

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description: stable code to branch on - the wording of detail may change, this will not

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: human-readable message, safe to show the user

concentration_pct_min.title: Concentration Pct Min
concentration_pct_min.description: percentage points, the floor for both concentration thresholds

concentration_pct_max.title: Concentration Pct Max
concentration_pct_max.description: percentage points, the ceiling for both concentration thresholds

description.title: Description
description.description: who the preset is for and what it treats as risky
examples: For a book whose job is not to lose money.

preset_key.title: Preset Key
preset_key.description: one of the keys from GET /health-config presets

config.title: Config
config.description: all seven HealthConfigValues fields, each inside the published bounds, with the three weights summing to 1

source.title: Source
source.description: where the active config came from: the built-in default, a preset the user chose, one derived from their goal, or hand-tuned values

preset_key.title: Preset Key
preset_key.description: the preset the user chose. Null when the values are hand-tuned or still the default

derived_preset_key.title: Derived Preset Key
derived_preset_key.description: the preset their goal implies, offered as a suggestion. Null when there is no goal to derive one from

default_preset_key.title: Default Preset Key
default_preset_key.description: what a reset falls back to

weight_sector_concentration.title: Weight Sector Concentration
weight_sector_concentration.description: fraction of the score from sector spread; the three weights sum to 1

weight_single_position.title: Weight Single Position
weight_single_position.description: fraction of the score from the largest single holding

weight_breadth.title: Weight Breadth
weight_breadth.description: fraction of the score from the effective number of positions

concentration_low.title: Concentration Low
concentration_low.description: percentage points in one holding where concentration starts counting against the score

concentration_high.title: Concentration High
concentration_high.description: percentage points in one holding that scores zero on that factor

hhi_well_spread.title: Hhi Well Spread
hhi_well_spread.description: sector Herfindahl index that earns full marks; 0.15 is roughly seven evenly-weighted sectors, and lower means more spread

breadth_target_n.title: Breadth Target N
breadth_target_n.description: effective positions that earn full marks on breadth

score.title: Score
score.description: structural risk out of 10, weighted from the subscores. Null for an empty portfolio, where there is nothing to score

label.title: Label
label.description: Excellent, Healthy, Mixed or Needs attention. Null whenever score is

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: fraction of the overall score, not percentage points; the three weights sum to 1

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: what the number says about this book right now
examples: Financials is 34% of the book, and the sector HHI is 0.28.

target.title: Target
target.description: what full marks would take, in the user's own terms
examples: HHI at or below 0.15 (roughly 7+ evenly-weighted sectors)

improvement.title: Improvement
improvement.description: the one move that would raise this factor
examples: Adding exposure outside Financials would bring this HHI down.

name.title: Name
name.description: short label for the chart axis

value.title: Value
value.description: rand value of the book that day

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.description: the blended benchmark rebased to the same starting rand value. Null on days the benchmark could not be fetched

twr_index.title: Twr Index
twr_index.description: time-weighted index starting at 100, so deposits do not read as growth. Null when there are fewer than two snapshots to link

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: the imported statement this portfolio came from. Null if it was not created by an import

account_type.title: Account Type
account_type.description: zar, tfsa or usd. Null until the user sets it

total_value.title: Total Value
total_value.description: rand value of every priced holding at the price the dashboard used

total_cost.title: Total Cost
total_cost.description: what was paid for those holdings, including brokerage

daily_change_pct.title: Daily Change Pct
daily_change_pct.description: percentage points moved since the previous close. Null when no holding has a live price to compare

daily_change_value.title: Daily Change Value
daily_change_value.description: the same move in rands. Null on the same condition

email.title: Email
email.description: doubles as the Cognito username, so it cannot be changed later

password.title: Password
password.description: at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a special character. Cognito applies its own policy on top of this one

user_sub.title: User Sub
user_sub.description: Cognito's id for the new account. The EquityLens user id only exists after the first authenticated request

portfolio_value.title: Portfolio Value
portfolio_value.description: rand value of every holding, priced or not

invested_capital.title: Invested Capital
invested_capital.description: cost basis of the holdings still held, so it falls when you sell

net_contributions.title: Net Contributions
net_contributions.description: deposits less withdrawals from the statement, which can exceed invested_capital when cash is sitting uninvested

unrealised_gain.title: Unrealised Gain
unrealised_gain.description: paper gain on holdings that have a real price; cost-priced holdings are left out so they cannot fake a zero move

realised_gain.title: Realised Gain
realised_gain.description: locked in by sales, on an average-cost basis

total_costs.title: Total Costs
total_costs.description: brokerage and fees charged over the statement period

simple_return_pct.title: Simple Return Pct
simple_return_pct.description: percentage points: unrealised gain over cost, ignoring when the money went in. Null when nothing is priced above its cost basis

money_weighted_return_pct.title: Money Weighted Return Pct
money_weighted_return_pct.description: percentage points, annualised XIRR over the cash flows, so it also reflects the timing of deposits. Null when XIRR does not converge

time_weighted_return_pct.title: Time Weighted Return Pct
time_weighted_return_pct.description: percentage points, chain-linked between snapshots with deposits and purchases taken out, so it measures the holdings rather than the deposits. This is the one to compare against an index. Null with fewer than two snapshots

snapshot_count.title: Snapshot Count
snapshot_count.description: daily valuations on record; two is the minimum for a time-weighted figure

history_days.title: History Days
history_days.description: days since the earliest snapshot. Null when there are none

priced_live_count.title: Priced Live Count
priced_live_count.description: holdings priced from a live quote today

priced_count.title: Priced Count
priced_count.description: holdings priced from anything other than cost, so live plus statement prices

value.title: Value
value.description: rand value held in this sector

percentage.title: Percentage
percentage.description: percentage points of the book, so the slices sum to 100

status.title: Status
status.description: what completed, one word per route

StatusResponse.title: StatusResponse
StatusResponse.description: confirm, mfa/confirm-setup, logout and DELETE /me all answer with just a status.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: send as the bearer token on every other route

id_token.title: Id Token
id_token.description: carries the profile claims; not accepted as a bearer token

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: outlives the other two and buys a new access_token

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: base32 seed to put in the authenticator app, by QR code or by hand. It is shown once and is not retrievable afterwards

id.title: Id
id.description: the EquityLens user id, not the Cognito sub

is_active.title: Is Active
is_active.description: false once the account has been deactivated; it can no longer sign in

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: when the EquityLens row was created, which is the first sign-in, not when the Cognito account was registered
